description: This file implements a RateLimiter class for managing API request and token rate limits, including handling errors, pausing on resource exhaustion, and tracking usage records.

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: A class that manages rate limiting for models, including request and token limits, error handling, and usage tracking.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles errors, particularly resource exhaustion errors, and pauses the rate limiter accordingly.

methods.name: acquirePermit
methods.description: Attempts to acquire permission for a request, respecting rate limits and pausing if necessary.

methods.name: recordUsage
methods.description: Records usage of tokens and requests for rate limiting purposes.
